field_text_policy.raw_user_message: preserve exact value; LF allowed; reject NUL, TAB, CR, remaining C0, DEL, and C1 controls
field_text_policy.event_title: preserve exact value; reject all C0, DEL, and C1 controls
field_text_policy.event_location: preserve exact value; reject all C0, DEL, and C1 controls
field_text_policy.task_title: preserve exact value; reject all C0, DEL, and C1 controls
field_text_policy.candidate_and_target_display_title: preserve exact value; reject all C0, DEL, and C1 controls
field_text_policy.provider_generated_question_and_error_te: preserve exact value; reject all C0, DEL, and C1 controls
field_text_policy.description: preserve exact value; LF is the only permitted control; reject NUL, TAB, CR, remaining C0, DEL, and C1 controls

json_output: compact, no whitespace, no BOM, slash unescaped
timestamp_policy: execution_expires_at is UTC second precision; persisted completion and derived RFC3339 timestamps allow at most six fractional digits and preserve the source fraction
